questions.question: Why did this project exist (problem statement)?
questions.answer: Duplicate credits and unclear retries under peak load; regulatory pressure to improve traceability.

questions.question: What was uniquely yours on this project?
questions.answer: Owned idempotency keys, retry semantics, and joint cutover plan with Risk.

questions.question: What metrics moved post-launch (or what qualitative signal confirmed success)?
questions.answer: Duplicate credit tickets dropped ~90% in first month; error budget stable through Black Friday.
